This season saw a number of new clubs enter the Championship. along with a new format.<br>
It was contested by 9 teams, and [[R.F.C. de Liège|F.C. Liégeois]] won the championship.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018 |archive-date=13 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220713200355/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
